spec.name: Afulay Forum of Amazigh Theater
spec.description: Forum in Tiznit dedicated to Amazigh-language theater, showcasing plays and theatrical creation in Tamazight, encouraging its use on stage and building bridges between researchers, practitioners and young theater amateurs.

editions.notes: Rescheduled from the usual period due to the COVID-19 pandemic
